text: The Terraform module boundaries are set. Now we plan what actually runs inside AKS: grain-ingest's Helm chart, its autoscaling strategy, and a pod-level network lockdown.
The HPA scales grain-ingest from 3 to 15 replicas on 70% CPU -- sized against last year's peak harvest intake, with headroom for a real spike.
A NetworkPolicy restricts Azure SQL access to only pods labeled app: ingest. It's applied by kubectl, deliberately kept outside the Helm chart's own release cycle.
That split is a real zero-trust pattern: security can tighten the network rule without waiting on an app release, and an app release doesn't carry a security review gate every time.
The platform design is locked. Next: planning the budget alerts and the reliability dashboard that watches cost and database load side by side.
